game.title: Kingdom Come: Deliverance II
game.blurb: Story-rich open-world medieval RPG from Warhorse Studios, released 2025-02-03. RAWG average playtime: 28 hours. Genres: Action, Adventure, RPG. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

chapters.title: The Main Story
chapters.summary: Henry and Hans Capon's journey from the Trosky region to Kuttenberg.

chapters.title: Side Quests and Characters
chapters.summary: Optional quests and the people met along the way.

chapters.title: Combat, Stealth and Skills
chapters.summary: Combos, archery, crossbows, stealth kills, brawling and weapon variety.

chapters.title: Pastimes and Minigames
chapters.summary: Dice, horse racing, shooting contests, shield painting and pilgrimages.

chapters.title: Expansions
chapters.summary: Legacy of the Forge, Brushes with Death and Mysteria Ecclesiae.

chapters.title: Hardcore Mode
chapters.summary: Finishing the game in Hardcore mode, with or without every negative perk.

StrategyWiki: no page for this game, nothing used
Fandom (kingdomcomedeliverance.fandom.com, CC BY-SA): page names only were checked to confirm structure; no text copied — https://kingdomcomedeliverance.fandom.com/wiki/Kingdom_Come:_Deliverance_II
notes: No StrategyWiki page. kingdomcomedeliverance.fandom.com answers the API with about 50 linked pages, including an achievements page and the three expansions (Legacy of the Forge, Brushes with Death, Mysteria Ecclesiae); names only were looked at, nothing copied. 83 Steam achievements, many hidden; DLC achievements were grouped by their visible conditions where possible. Hidden achievements are placed in the main story chapter as a placeholder and need checking.
